trends.note: Google Trends is relative (0-100) and can be distorted by seasonality and, as Camillo later argued (2025), by AI-generated query traffic. Treat spikes that contradict other signals with caution.

lead.reason: Yahoo already shows rating downgrades in January 2020 (Standpoint Buy→Hold on 16 Jan, BofA Buy→Neutral on 27 Jan), before the February window. The 20 Feb Morgan Stanley $3 target trim (147→144, Equal-Weight maintained) is not a thesis catch-up, and we do not report a 5-day lead from a mid-month placeholder to that trim. The first large target cut is Morgan Stanley 144→85 on 30 Mar — after the self-reported early-March exit. Equity path is not put P&L.
lead.zh: 时差不可用（不是零）。1 月已有降级；2 月 20 日仅 3 美元目标微调不算「卖方追上」；3 月 30 日大幅下调目标价已在他自称的 3 月初退出之后。标的路径不是看跌期权损益。
lead.en: Lead time unavailable (not zero). Downgrades already appeared in January; a $3 trim on 20 Feb is not a catch-up; the large 30 Mar target cut is after the self-reported early-March exit. Equity path is not put P&L.
